plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Spec-driven Claude Code plugin. Audit a repo for the work worth doing, grill business + technical goals as distinct passes, plan into a dependency-ordered task graph, build hands-off. Product memory is queried record sets loaded by role (.claude/product.yaml for North Star + Language, roadmap.yaml, architecture.yaml, lessons.yaml) via skills/outputty/docs.js, which requires the bun runtime; durable lessons live in Claude Code's auto-memory; the laziest-working-diff build discipline is owned in-plugin.
